featured_reviews.review_text:

The VR headset and equipment were super clean and comfortable, and the whole setup was well maintained. Each ride lasted about 10 minutes, which was just the right length for me. At ₹200 per person per ride, it's a bit on the pricier side, but the experience is definitely worth it.

The VR rides were the highlight of our visit, but the arcade games were also fun and engaging. The bowling alley, though small, was still enjoyable, and I had a good time. The only downside was that the place can get quite crowded, especially on weekends, and the AC sometimes struggles to keep up

Despite the occasional crowd and warm temperatures, I had a great time at Timezone Capital Mall

featured_reviews.review_text: Visited Thrillville with a group of friends and we had the time of our lives. featured_reviews.name: Jennifer Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited ThrillVille Entertainment Zone yesterday. While the overall concept of the place is good, we felt that several areas need much better maintenance, hygiene, and customer attention.

The go-karting experience was decent, but many of the cars did not seem to be maintained properly, which affected both the experience and the safety aspect.

Similarly, during the Splash Waterpark adventure, the water had a very unpleasant fishy smell and did not appear clean or regularly maintained. Hygiene is extremely important in water-based activities, and this was quite disappointing.

Another major concern was the staff behavior at the Splash Waterpark adventure area. Instead of actively supervising and assisting children, some staff members appeared more occupied enjoying themselves and were not attentive to kids who were struggling to climb back onto the adventure setup from the water. It felt like there was very little concern or support being provided, which was disappointing from a safety and customer service perspective.

Considering the amount charged for these activities, we expected a much better standard of upkeep, cleanliness, and staff involvement. Proper maintenance, regular cleaning, and more responsible staff supervision would greatly improve the overall experience.

Unfortunately, this visit did not meet our expectations, and personally, I may not consider visiting again. I sincerely hope the management takes customer feedback seriously and works on improving the facilities and service for future visitors.

featured_reviews.name: Trunali Mestry
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing time at Thrillville Entertainment Zone! The place is packed with fun activities for all age groups and is perfect for spending quality time with family and friends. The games and attractions are well-maintained, the staff is friendly and helpful, and the overall atmosphere is energetic and enjoyable.

A great destination for fun, adventure, and creating memorable moments. Highly recommended if you're looking for an exciting day out❤️✨💥

featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited thrillvilla on my birthday which was planned by my girlfriend and I had the best time. I would suggest going here with a grp of 6-8 people and on weekdays to avoid rush.

featured_reviews.name: Milind Gavkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Really big and spacious play ground in Vasai!

Vasai Kala Krida Mahotsav is the annual attraction over here. Several outdoor and indoor games like running, chess, carom, table tennis, badminton, cricket, etc. are held on Vasai Virar City Municipal Corporation (VVCMC) ground. Vasai Kala Krida Mahotsav has largest fan following in the vicinity. Many seasonedprofessionalls participate in abovementioned games.

Notably in chess, many internationally rated also known as 'FIDE rated' players do participates every year.

The play ground is available for the entire year for sports activities. It is nicely maintained by Vasai Virar City Municipal Corporation.

The ground is aptly named as Chimaji Appa Ground in the memory of Chimaji Appa, was an Indian statesman and military commander of the Maratha Empire. Chimaji Aapa conquered the Vasai fort in his era.

I often watch movies at Miraj Cinemas Dattani, mainly because it’s convenient and close by. If you don’t want to travel far and just want to catch a movie nearby, it does the job.
That said, you do have to compromise a bit on the overall experience. The sound and screen quality are decent but not premium, and the seating comfort could definitely be better. The overall ambience feels slightly outdated compared to newer cinemas in other areas.
Cleanliness is acceptable and the staff is fine, but nothing really stands out. It’s more about convenience than a high-end cinematic experience.

featured_reviews.name: Aquib Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience at Up in the Air Trampoline Park, Vasai.

The biggest concern was safety. I noticed that part of the ceiling appeared damaged, with a section hanging down while children were playing directly underneath. As a parent or visitor, this is very worrying because it creates a potential safety risk if any loose material were to fall.

Another disappointment was the volleyball area. The court and nets were present, but there was no volleyball available. When I asked a staff member, I was told that balls were not being provided because the ceiling had been damaged due to people throwing them. If that’s the case, the attraction should either be properly maintained or temporarily closed instead of being left unusable.

The staff were also not very helpful. Some crew members seemed occupied on their phones, and getting assistance or proper responses was difficult. Customer service felt lacking throughout the visit.

To make matters worse, the air conditioning was either not functioning properly or not switched on despite the extreme summer heat. Spending time inside the facility became quite uncomfortable.

Maintenance overall appeared poor, especially considering the entry fee of around ₹400 per hour. For the amount being charged, visitors should expect a safe, well-maintained, and fully functional facility.

I also observed adults and children using the same trampoline areas at the same time, which did not seem to be monitored adequately. This raises additional safety concerns, particularly for younger children.

The property itself has a lot of potential and could be an excellent family entertainment destination, but in its current condition it feels neglected and poorly managed. Unfortunately, this visit was more frustrating than enjoyable, and I would not recommend it until major improvements are made in safety, maintenance, and customer service.

featured_reviews.review_text: Tried the Up in the Air trampoline park in Vasai West today. Setup is good with plenty of room, and the staff is supportive. featured_reviews.name: Sweety J M
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited Post Office Restaurant, Vasai yesterday(19/4/2026) for a family dinner. This place has been special to us for many years, and we’ve always had great experiences—so this visit was genuinely disappointing.

To begin with, the staff seemed extremely confused, and there was no visible manager on the floor to handle operations. Everyone appeared to be working independently, with no coordination or proper system in place. Even placing an order was difficult—we had to call staff multiple times.

After ordering, the situation didn’t improve. The serving staff had no clarity about which dish belonged to which table. They kept moving around asking each table, “Did you order this?” which felt quite unprofessional.

We also noticed food and drinks sitting unattended on a side table for a long time. Unless guests themselves asked about their orders, nothing was being served. When the food finally arrived, it was cold, and the naan was chewy, which affected the overall dining experience.

To make matters worse, most tables—including ours—received incorrect bills with extra items added. This led to further delays as corrections had to be made.

Overall, there was a significant lack of management, coordination, and basic service standards. It resulted in a lot of wasted time and frustration.

We truly have many fond memories associated with this restaurant, which is why this experience was even more disappointing. We hope the management takes this feedback seriously, improves staff training, and restores the quality and service the place was once known for.

featured_reviews.name: Ramesh Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience.
We ordered a pizza and were told it would arrive in 10 minutes, but it took around 40 minutes. By the time the food arrived, our bowling game had already ended. When we requested cancellation due to the excessive delay, the staff insisted on bringing it anyway.
The bigger issue was the complete lack of coordination among the staff. We were seated at a table by one waiter, and later another staff member (surname Chikne) came and told us to leave because the table was reserved. When I explained that their own waiter had seated us there, he denied it. Only after confronting both staff members together did the waiter finally admit that he had indeed seated us there.
To make matters worse, when we asked for drinking water before leaving, we were told they don't serve water. We then asked for a Bisleri bottle and were informed that wasn't available either.
Poor service, poor communication, long delays, and rude customer handling. The staff seemed more interested in arguing than resolving customer issues. Definitely not the experience one expects after paying for a fun outing.
Would not recommend until management improves staff training and customer service. 👎

The gaming arcade was equally impressive, offering a mix of classic games like Pac-Man and thrilling VR experiences that transported me into another world. The variety ensures there’s something for everyone, from kids to adults looking to relive their arcade days.

featured_reviews.name: Chinmay Prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text: We went here primarily for bowling. We purchased an offline card. We paid 3100 plus tax(3600) and got 3500 as balance. We also got a BOGO offer in bowling. We selected VIP bowling and it had animation and graphics on the bowling floor and of course the normal bowling was crowded. They have very good combination of arcade and normal games and we had fun here. Staff was very helpful and we had some issues with machine and my card got swiped multiple times. They understood my issue and offered me different games. We collected lot of tickets which acts like a currency for some of the items. They have a free bowling round on birthdays. They also have lot of offers and we got few extra bonus points for their social media posts.

featured_reviews.name: Saunskaar Parab
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited SHOTT Mumbai for my college event, and it was an amazing experience. The venue offers a fantastic arcade, a bowling area, a section for drinks and snacks, and dedicated rooms for parties and events. The vibe here is superb, and the staff is incredibly cooperative, making the experience even better. If you're looking for a fun and lively place for entertainment or events, SHOTT Mumbai is definitely worth checking out!

featured_reviews.name: Aishwarya chellath
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a really good experience . The vibe is great, music was nice, and the staff was super friendly and attentive. Food and drinks were fresh and well presented. Perfect place to chill with friends and have a fun evening. Would definitely visit again!

name: SHOTT Nesco
description: SHOTT is an iconic indoor amusement centre that impresses a 3-year-old Kid to a 70-year-old Grandparent. It is power-packed with simulative games, bowling, Laser Wars, party banquets and place for finger-licking food. It offers customized packages for organizing birthday parties, corporate events, product launches, award functions, annual day events, kitty parties, school picnics and more. Shott also arranges live screenings of sports matches to boost the action in players and gaming tournaments for sports enthusiasts to show their action and win unbelievable prices
address: Gate 2, Western Express Hwy, NESCO, Goregaon East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400063

featured_reviews.name: Megha Solanki
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Shoot Bowling for the first time and it was a truly lovely and happy experience. We thoroughly enjoyed playing bowling — the atmosphere was lively and perfect for a fun outing. Their quick bites and cocktails were also surprisingly good, making the overall experience even better.

It’s a great place to relax, have fun with friends or family, and enjoy some tasty food and drinks alongside the games. I’d definitely recommend it for anyone looking for a cheerful and entertaining time out.
This place doesnt have games for toddlers.

featured_reviews.name: AKSHAY PUTHRAN
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a nice place to visit to play various types of games such as Bowling, Arcade games and laser tag. It is at a walkable distance from Ram mandir station and the Goregaon East metro station. The place is very spacious. There are 2 types of Bowling available with slightly different pricing. The staff is very knowledgeable and helpful. They also offer variety of startes and mocktails available (if opted for specific packages). Highly recommend for fun activities with Friends and office colleagues.

featured_reviews.name: Karan Ashar
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a power pact experience with all my college mates as a re union staff and food was just amazing and on top service. Despite on a jam packed weekend evening we were given priority for bowling and the vibe was just amazing thanks a lot

featured_reviews.name: Rishit Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great experience at SHOTT Nesco! The place is huge, modern, and packed with entertainment options like bowling, arcade games, VR experiences, and laser tag. The atmosphere is energetic and perfect for friends, family outings, birthdays, or team events. The bowling lanes and gaming zones are well maintained, and the staff is generally helpful and friendly. The food and drinks are decent, though service can be a little slow during peak hours. It can get crowded on weekends, but the overall experience is definitely worth it.

featured_reviews.name: Sheetal D'Souza
featured_reviews.review_text:

Got preferential treatment for my kid as it was his birthday too .

featured_reviews.name: kevin shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Shott Nesco for an evening outing

Tried bowling, laser tag, and arcade games - all were fun and well-managed

Went around 4 PM, so there was less crowd and minimal waiting time

Ambiance was lively and perfect for friends or family

Had food there; prices were decent for the quality

Overall, a great entertainment spot and worth visiting, especially during off-peak hours
